title: Nyon Bay Festival
tagline: New Year's Eve at Dubai Islands ft. Thaikkudam Bridge & Arivu
description: A New Year's Eve waterfront festival at Dubai Islands, running from 7pm to 3am. Kayal Events partnered with Vibe Events and Wonderwall to bring Thaikkudam Bridge, Arivu and a lineup of independent artists to the Sea Point Hotel for a night that closed out 2025.

shows.venue: Sea Point Hotel, Dubai Islands, Deira
